entities.summary: Carlo Emilio Bonferroni was an Italian mathematician who worked on probability theory. Bonferroni is best known for the Bonferroni inequalities, and for the Bonferroni correction in statistics, which he did not invent, but which is related to the Bonferroni inequalities.
